# Create a differential test with deep chains and multiple roots using functions from test_cost_scaling_quota
import sys,random,importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0,'submission');sys.path.insert(0,'tmp');sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
# load module (it runs its test on import, avoid by extracting definitions)
src=open('tmp/test_cost_scaling_quota.py').read().split('random.seed(123)')[0]
ns={};exec(src,ns)
from common import validate
import planning
random.seed(7)
def forest_chains(nchains, depth, capmax=10):
 nodes=[]
 for c in range(nchains):
  for d in range(depth):
   i=c*depth+d
   nodes.append({'id':f'n{i}','parent':None if d==0 else f'n{i-1}','capacity':random.randrange(0,capmax+1)})
 return nodes
for trial in range(300):
 nc=random.randrange(1,5); depth=random.randrange(1,33)
 rq=forest_chains(nc,depth)
 oc=random.randrange(1,5); od=random.randrange(1,33)
 oq=forest_chains(oc,od)
 R=random.randrange(1,15);O=random.randrange(1,15)
 leases=[{'id':'l','prefix':'2001:db8::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}]
 reqs=[{'id':f'r{i}','at':0,'lease':'l','target':f'2001:db8::{i+1}','service':'s','group':random.choice(rq)['id']} for i in range(R)]
 offers=[]
 for j in range(O):
  offers.append({'id':f'o{j}','time':random.randrange(0,100),'service':'s','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':random.randrange(0,10),'cost':random.choice([0,1,10**9,500000000]),'group':random.choice(oq)['id'],'requests':[f'r{i}' for i in range(R) if random.random()<0.5]})
 job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':leases,'services':[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[0],'captures':[],'requests':reqs,'offers':offers,'request_quotas':rq,'offer_quotas':oq}
 ctx=validate(job);active={f'r{i}':random.random()<0.8 for i in range(R)}
 ref=planning.solve(ctx,active)
 res=ns['build_cs'](ctx,active)
 cs,rounds=res if res else (None,0)
 got=(0,0) if cs is None else (cs['resolved'],cs['cost'])
 if got!=(ref['resolved'],ref['cost']):
  print('MISMATCH',trial,depth,od,R,O,got,(ref['resolved'],ref['cost']),rounds);break
else:print('deep chain differential OK')
EOF
